body:
Adds `research/holdout-market`: improvement-based payments against a hidden holdout (telescoping budget), a payment-feedback overfitting attack (raw rule paid 0.15 while the published model's true loss worsened 0.37), and a Ladder-style fix with its measured cost to honest small contributors. Pure-Python, 4 tests, white paper, portfolio page and README updated.
